description: The craft of the WORDS in a demovid demo — the two model calls that write prose, why narration is composed for the ear instead of the page, how many words actually fit in a shot of a given length, how many steps a demo should have, and what the opening and closing lines have to accomplish. Use whenever you edit the storyboard or commercial prompt in `src/openai/script.ts` or `src/openai/commercial.ts`, tune a preset's `targetWpm` or step count, write or review a `say`/`caption`/`impact`/hook line, or judge a demo that is accurate but boring, too long, reads like a manual, or narrated at a speed no viewer can follow. This is about prose and pacing, not about JSON Schema mechanics or where the cuts land.

must_trigger: the narration reads like written prose instead of speech
how many spoken words fit in a three second shot
the demo is accurate but boring and too long
rewrite the opening line so it states the benefit
must_not_trigger: the Studio preview shows the title at a different size than the rendered mp4
a hard 400 from the Structured Outputs API on a storyboard
the recorder was left capturing after a crash
regenerate the baked spring easing curves

claims.why: a regra central: a narração é composta para o ouvido, e o prompt diz isso explicitamente
o comprimento é uma regra do prompt, não gosto: menos de 4 não é demo, mais de 12 é manual
a abertura tem um movimento definido: apresentar o app enquanto a primeira frase toca

claims.needle: the viewer may start reading mid-loop
claims.why: caption do modo silencioso é outro campo com outro trabalho — lido a frio, possivelmente do meio do loop

claims.needle: NEVER repeat what the narration already says
claims.why: voz e texto são dois canais; dizer a mesma coisa duas vezes desperdiça os dois

claims.needle: Diz o benefício, não o nome da tela
claims.why: a regra de copy do gancho, no lugar onde o modelo a lê
o ritmo do preset comercial é o número de onde sai a aritmética palavras-por-segundo
o teto acima do qual instructions satura — o limite que separa ritmo pedido de ritmo entregue
